events.title: Elmwood Holiday Market
events.why: Free neighborhood holiday street market in the Elmwood shopping district, one of two dates this season.

events.title: Festival of Lights: A Diwali Celebration
events.why: Free library-run Diwali afternoon with dance, crafts and food, a one-off community cultural event close to home.

events.title: Glow Festival at the Exploratorium
events.why: One-day festival of light-based exhibits and demos at the Exploratorium, a strong fit for science-minded older kids.

events.title: Math Festival at San Jose Public Library
events.why: Free hands-on math puzzles and games festival, a one-day library event aimed squarely at school-age kids.

events.title: West Coast Craft Winter Market
events.why: Free twice-a-year design and craft fair with hundreds of independent makers, good for early holiday shopping.

events.title: Ernie's Trains neighborhood model railroad display
events.why: Free front-yard display of five model train tracks that runs evenings Nov 26 to Dec 26 except Mondays, a local-knowledge Peninsula tradition.

events.title: Free Thanksgiving Day at San Francisco Botanical Garden
events.venue: San Francisco Botanical Garden, Golden Gate Park
events.why: The garden waives admission for everyone on Thanksgiving Day, a quiet morning walk before dinner.

events.title: Indigenous Peoples' Thanksgiving Sunrise Gathering on Alcatraz
events.why: Annual pre-dawn ceremony on Alcatraz honoring the 1969 occupation; ferries leave Pier 33 between 4:15 and 5:15am and tickets are limited.

events.title: San Francisco Turkey Trot
events.why: Thanksgiving-morning 5K and 10K through Golden Gate Park with a kids' run, a once-a-year family tradition.

events.title: Christmas in the Park opening weekend
events.why: Downtown San José's free holiday village of decorated trees and displays opens Nov 27; open noon to 10pm Fri-Sun during the window.

events.title: Holiday Light Spectacular opening night
events.why: Free drive-and-walk light show at the Marin Center that opens Nov 27 and runs Fri-Sun evenings 5-9pm.

events.title: Holidays at Filoli
events.why: Daytime holiday house and garden from $40, or the evening Holiday Lights walk 4-10pm from $45; the closest big light display to Menlo Park.

events.title: Joseph and the Amazing Technicolor Dreamcoat
events.venue: Los Altos Stage Company, 97 Hillview Ave
events.why: Local community theater run of the family musical opens Nov 27 and continues through Dec 20, a short drive from Menlo Park.

events.title: Lightscape at San Francisco Botanical Garden
events.venue: San Francisco Botanical Garden, Golden Gate Park
events.why: Mile-long illuminated art trail through the botanical garden, nightly through Jan 3, a seasonal evening outing for the long weekend.

events.title: Roaring Camp Holiday Lights Train
events.why: Lighted vintage train with carolers departs the Boardwalk at 5:00 and 6:30pm on Nov 27-28; the page lists dates but confirm the year when booking.

events.title: Santa Lights the Square: Ghirardelli Square tree lighting
events.why: Free Black Friday tree lighting with Santa's arrival, carolers and chocolate, a once-a-year waterfront kickoff.

events.title: Vault Garden Winter Wonderland opening
events.why: Adults-only pick: the downtown restaurant's heated outdoor holiday dining and cocktail installation opens Nov 27, geared to a parents' night out.

events.title: Alice in Wonderland: Panto in the Presidio
events.why: British-style holiday pantomime with audience participation opens Nov 28, well suited to a 9-14 age range.

events.title: Cirque Kalabanté: WOW (World of Words)
events.why: Guinean acrobatic circus at Cal Performances, Nov 28 2pm and Nov 29 3pm, a family-friendly holiday-season show rather than a stadium act.

events.title: Fellowship of Craft Marketplace
events.venue: Henry J. Kaiser Center for the Arts
events.why: Free two-day juried craft and design fair Nov 28-29, 10am-5pm, in the restored Kaiser Center.

events.title: Great Dickens Christmas Fair (Thanksgiving weekend)
events.why: The 42nd annual immersive Victorian London fair runs weekends through Dec 20, including Nov 22 and the Fri-Sun after Thanksgiving; a classic once-a-year Bay Area outing.

events.title: Hook in Concert with the San Francisco Symphony
events.why: The 1991 Spielberg film screened with live orchestra Nov 27-28, with kids' tickets half off.

events.title: IlluminOdyssey 10th anniversary light exhibits
events.why: Interactive light-and-science installations celebrating their tenth year, open daily through Jan 24, a good Thanksgiving-break outing for 9-14 year olds.

events.title: San Francisco Crystal Fair
events.venue: SF County Fair Building, 1199 Ninth Ave
events.why: Twice-a-year crystal, mineral and jewelry fair Nov 28 10-6 and Nov 29 10-4; $14 at the door with an $11 Funcheap discount, kids 12 and under free.

events.title: The Velveteen Rabbit (ODC/Dance)
events.venue: Yerba Buena Center for the Arts
events.why: ODC's annual holiday dance production opens Nov 28 and runs through Dec 6, a San Francisco seasonal staple.

events.title: Yerba Buena Gardens holiday tree and carousel lighting
events.why: Third annual free tree and LeRoy King Carousel lighting with free ice skating, RSVP required.

events.title: Los Altos Festival of Lights Parade
events.venue: Downtown Los Altos (Main and State streets)
events.why: Once-a-year lighted parade ten minutes from Menlo Park, with lit floats, marching bands and giant balloons; arrive early for curb space.

events.title: Angels Singing: An Early Music Christmas
events.why: Free early-music Christmas concert in Stanford's Memorial Church, a one-night event minutes from home.
